$comment: Canonical branding.json reference. Copy to branding.json, edit for your instance, and upload to the config bucket root. The React UI fetches it at page load and applies colors/fonts as --brand-* CSS variables (src/hooks/use_branding.ts). Omitted keys fall back to the shipped design tokens in src/index.css. One instance, one file.

fonts.body: Google Sans Text, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif

suggestions: How has average annual wage changed over time in the United States?
Compare GDP growth across G7 countries
What is the gender wage gap in OECD countries?

metrics.$comment: Optional Key Metrics dashboard composition. When omitted entirely, the UI uses its built-in DEFAULT_METRICS_TABS. Each tile maps 1:1 to a <datacommons-${type}> web component.
